Chair facts now carry a live flag on running entries, per-task approval hold ages and the resolved hold limit, and release_approvals is a declared action kind. No planner, exec or cli code changed. Two existing tests pinned exact running-entry dicts and the facts-deps wiring list, so I updated them: test_chair_facts_steer.py, test_chair_facts_phases.py and test_chair_run_wiring.py. This goes beyond the four planned files. The first full chair run had one failure, in the wiring test, which I fixed. I did not rerun the whole chair suite afterwards. I reran only test_chair_run_wiring.py, test_chair_facts_approval_holds.py and test_chair_types.py (93 passed). Ruff check passes on src/tools. I did not run the other two suites in .agent-checks (src/graphs and src/cartridges), the clean check, or the type checker. Counting rule I chose: the action rows carry no tick id, so one tick is one distinct `ts` among the matching rows. A row matches a task when its task_id equals the task's id, or when it has no task_id and names the task's initiative. Counted kinds are land, land_phase and steer_clear. A land or land_phase row with status landed or done resets the count. Merged tasks are skipped, and tasks with a zero count get no entry. If one tick stamps its rows with different ts values, the count will run high.
